title: Your Blueprint Title
description: A one-paragraph summary of what this system helps the user accomplish. Focus on the outcome, not the features. This appears in the sidebar and Vault.
outcome: The single measurable outcome the user achieves by completing this blueprint
category: Choose from: audience-building | content-marketing | seo | conversion | productivity | workflow | business | creative

modules.title: Module Title
modules.description: A 1-2 sentence description of what this module covers and why it matters.
outcome: What the user will achieve by the end of this module (3-5 items)
Each item should be a specific, measurable deliverable
Use action verbs: Define, Create, Build, Set up, Implement

steps.title: Action Step Title
steps.description: One sentence explaining what to do in this step. Make it immediately actionable.
steps.details: A paragraph with the detailed instructions. Keep it under 150 words. Focus on exactly what the user needs to do. Include specific examples, tools, or resources they should use. Avoid theory and background context.
